reason: Lists the few profiles on this computer, every one at once by design (WC-ACCT-12), as gcal-cli's session list does; a filter would let a caller narrow it to one and read that as the only profile.

`move` takes a CRM record to another stage of its funnel (plan 2026-11-06-bitrix24-cli §4.2.6); the cli-base flag vocabulary has no flag for a stage, and --to means a chat or an address. Add --stage there with the other CRM flags (NEED-2280's neighbour), then drop this.

Calls one Bitrix24 method by its API name, the same command gcal-cli and drive-cli have; no shared verb names a raw API call. Review when the vocabulary names it: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/425

The portal's own (custom) fields of deals, leads, people and organizations, which `--set` and the list query take by label (plan 2026-11-06-bitrix24-cli §4.4); the cli-base vocabulary has no noun for a record type's field definitions yet. Add `fields` there with the CRM nouns, then drop this.
